subject: HealthBridge DPA: retention carveout & backup purge routing
messages:
From: Priya Reddy <priya.reddy@healthbridge.com>
To: sean.gallagher@redwood.ai
Cc: legal@healthbridge.com
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Retention carveout request + DPA annex

Hi Sean,

Thanks again for the call this morning. Legal has reviewed the main DPA but they asked for an explicit retention carveout for certain audit/logging artifacts generated by our integration (mainly debug traces and request logs retained for 24 months for regulatory reasons). They'd like to see: a) a short annex to the DPA that lists the carveout and b) a short operational runbook describing how Redwood will handle backup purges that intersect with that carveout.

Attached is HealthBridge_DPA_Retention_Annex_v3.pdf with the clause they proposed and an initial backup-purge timeline (hb-backup-purge-timeline.xlsx). The two asks from our side are: 1) can Redwood accept the carveout as-written or propose minimal language adjustments, and 2) can you confirm the mechanics of a backup purge exception (how requests are routed, who signs off, rollback steps) and an approximate timeline for implementing the runbook?

We are aiming for procurement/sign-off by the first week of December to meet our product cutover plan. Please loop in whoever owns DPA ops/scheduling on your side.

Thanks,
Priya
Priya Reddy
Head of Legal Operations, HealthBridge
priya.reddy@healthbridge.com

Subject: Re: Retention carveout request + DPA annex

Priya —

Appreciate the clear asks and the timeline. Quick responses inline below and a proposed mutual action plan: 

- Annex language: We reviewed the PDF and have two suggested edits (minor scope clarifications and a sentence about the customer-carrying responsibility for classification). I will attach our marked-up suggestions by EOD.
- Operational runbook / purge exceptions: We can support a temporary "log carveout" for the specified audit artifacts with an approval workflow. Proposed high-level steps:
  1) Customer (HealthBridge) opens an Exception Request (via our portal) that references the DPA annex and includes the retention justification.
  2) Security Ops + Product (Redwood) review for 48 business hours.
  3) If approved, we create a time-bound policy (TTL extended for specific buckets) and a purge hold flag on snapshots.
  4) We include explicit rollback steps and an immutable-mark for forensics if needed.

Timing: Karthik and Marissa will take point on the runbook and the portal flow. We can produce a one-page runbook draft within 3 business days and a full operational SOP within 10 business days after annex language is agreed. That should fit your first-week-of-December target if we get annex edits back by EOD tomorrow.

I've copied Kimberly for approval of the SLA-side exception and sign-off authority. Karthik / Marissa — can you pick this up?

—Sean
